description: Source code for TransportConnectJob class handling network socket connections, DNS resolution, and connection attempts in Chromium's networking stack.

classes.name: TransportSocketParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for socket transport, including destination endpoint, DNS policies, and supported ALPN protocols.

classes.name: TransportConnectJob
classes.description: Manages the process of resolving hostnames, establishing TCP connections, and handling IPv4/IPv6 fallback logic.

classes.name: TransportConnectJob::EndpointResultOverride
classes.description: Overrides endpoint results for testing or special cases, including DNS aliases.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns current load state of the connection process.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::HasEstablishedConnection
methods.description: Indicates if a connection has been established (always false here).

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::GetConnectionAttempts
methods.description: Returns the list of connection attempts made.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::GetResolveErrorInfo
methods.description: Returns error info from hostname resolution.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::GetHostResolverEndpointResult
methods.description: Returns current host resolver endpoint result.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::ConnectionTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for connection attempts.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::OnIOComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of asynchronous I/O operations.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::DoLoop
methods.description: Main loop processing different connection states.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::DoResolveHost
methods.description: Starts hostname resolution.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::DoResolveHostComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of hostname resolution.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::DoResolveHostCallbackComplete
methods.description: Processes DNS results and filters usable endpoints.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::DoTransportConnect
methods.description: Initiates TCP connection to resolved endpoints.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::DoTransportConnectComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of TCP connection attempts.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::HandleSubJobComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of IPv4/IPv6 sub-jobs.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::OnSubJobComplete
methods.description: Callback for sub-job completion.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::StartIPv4JobAsync
methods.description: Starts IPv4 connection asynchronously as fallback.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::ConnectInternal
methods.description: Begins the connection process.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::ChangePriorityInternal
methods.description: Updates request priority during hostname resolution.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::IsSvcbOptional
methods.description: Determines if SVCB/HTTPS endpoints are optional based on client support.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::IsEndpointResultUsable
methods.description: Checks if a DNS endpoint result is suitable for connection based on ALPN and metadata.

methods.name: TransportConnectJob::GetEndpointResultForCurrentSubJobs
methods.description: Retrieves current endpoint result for connection attempts.
